notes.title: Alpha 0.17 : Our Biggest Update so far !
notes.content:
What's up ?

[h1]New experimental zombies mode, new maps, new engine version, bug fixes...Welcome to 0.17![/h1]

[u][b]HIGHLIGHTS:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] ANOMALY, our new experimental zombie game mode is out.
[*] New maps and new environments: 1 new map in Strike and 3 new maps in Anomaly mode.
[*] New Achievements
[*] New Engine version.
[*] Bug fixes and optimizations.[/list]

[u][b]CHANGELOG[/b][/u]

[b]ANOMALY: [/b]

Anomaly use the same sets of rules than Strike but introduce a new threat: ZOMBIES !
The BIOS backstory allowing us to play with any environment and types of threats, we thought it would be fun to play with Zombies and see how it goes. We liked the result enough to release it and see what's your reaction about it.
The mode is experimental and therefore it would be really helpful if you could give us feedback on what you liked/disliked about it.
You can launch Anomaly directly from the main menu.

[b]MAPS & ENVIRONMENTS:[/b]

We've retired some maps, some others are in maintenance mode and we introduce new maps and environments.
In a nutshell: We've retired 8 maps (4 once for all and + 4 which will be back in an upcoming update) and introduce 4 new maps (featuring 2 new environments)

The maps retired (once for all) in STRIKE Mode are: 
- "Base_address_register" (Normal Difficulty mode)
- "FFFF_FFF0h" (Normal difficulty mode).
- "YOU DON'T EXIST. GO AWAY" (Hard Difficulty mode).
- "3.11" (Very Hard Difficulty mode).

The maps that move into maintenance mode in STRIKE are:
- "STARTUP SCREEN" (Normal Difficulty mode)
- "BAD SECTORS" (Hard Difficulty mode)
- "8087" (Very Hard Difficulty Mode)
- "404" (Very Hard Difficulty Mode)

The new maps are:

STRIKE:
- "Chipset Initialization" in (Normal Difficulty mode)

ANOMALY:
- "Creeper" (Normal Difficulty mode)
- "MyDoom" (Hard Difficulty mode)
- "Stuxnet" (Very Hard Difficulty mode)

The new total is 24 maps (21 in Strike and 3 in Anomaly).


[b]ACHIEVEMENTS:[/b]

5 New Achievements: 
- 10 Zombie Headshots
- 50 Zombie Kills
- 100 Zombie Kills
- 500 Zombie Kills
- 1000 Zombie Kills

[b]CHANGES/ENHANCEMENTS:[/b]

- Default Anti-Aliasing is now set to FXAA (was previously Temporal AA). Changes is motivated by rendering bug.
- If you point your mouse on a flag in the leaderboards, you can now get the name of the country. This allow you to identify the country of origin of each BIOS Runner more easily.
- Explosion for Humanoid AI is now more spectacular
- Main Menu has been updated to accommodate the new Anomaly Mode. 


[b]BUGS FIXES:[/b]

- Laser targeting systems used by the sniper turrets are now behaving in a more elegant -but still deadly- fashion. Thanks to Plotinus for reporting the issue.
- Fixed a bug which affected the way Units were being calculated. The fix allow us to retroactively gives you the Units you missed. In other words, expect your Units counter to jump and you might get achievements in the process (if you hit some thresholds). Thanks to Klooger and other fellow BIOS Runners for pointing this out.
- Fixed Exploits in some maps allowing you to jump out of the race. Thanks to Dinjoralo.

[b]ENGINE VERSION:[/b]

The game now use Unreal Engine 4.9.1 which means we have a first experimental DirectX 12 Supports. It is not ready for prime time yet but implementation has started thanks to Microsoft and Epic works.

Also lot of changes under the hood in preparation for an upcoming big update...

notes.title: Alpha 0.12 (Major Update)
notes.content:
[list]
 [*] Localization:  The game is now available in 6 new languages (French, German, Russian, Polish, Brazilian and Swedish). The localization should also be considered "Alpha" so if you spot some problems please let us know in the forums !

 [*] Faster than light [b]"Retry"[/b] ! Hit "L" (default key) while playing and restart the map instantaneously. No more loading screen ! Also works after a Game Over or if you want to replay a map you've just finished.

 [*] 3 new weapons (automatic rifles): The Scar in 5.56 MM configuration and 2 M4 Variants.
We've added them on some challenges in Strike Mode.

 [*] Steam Achievements: This is a first pass and we only have 14 of them for now but you can expect more in the future along some upcoming new gameplay features.

 [*] One map (PC Load Letter) move from hard to very hard. It's also being renamed in the process (Now called 8087)

 [*] Fix some physical objects acting weird in map like "3.11" and "95"

 [*] Graphical enhancements in some maps (mostly some textures now available in higher resolution)

 [*] On the main menu, your steam username, steam icon and total credits is now being displayed. This is a first pass for an upcoming profile space.

 [*] Country Flags : The game now display a country flag for each entry in the leaderboards.
Note: The game uses your connection location to determine the flag being displayed.
Also users who have not launched the game at least once since this update won't have a flag associated with their name. In other words: launch the game to get the flag.

 [*] Fix random crash when hitting "Play",  "Back to Main Menu" and "Exit" in some specific cases

 [*] New Steam banners to represent the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 0.10 (Major Update)
notes.content:
Hello Guys,

A lot of changes in this first major update !

[h1][u][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/u][/h1]

Our main intention with this update is:
- To make it easier to finish a map
- It is now harder to master and even harder to rush by avoiding most fights.
- Make the fight/encounters more nervous 

[i]How does this translate:[/i]
[list]
[*][b]HEALTH REGEN (NEW)[/b]
[/list]
Normal Difficulty mode: you regain 1 Hit Point (HP) per Second
Hard: 0.6 HP per Second
Very Hard: 0.3 HP per Second
Extreme Difficulty: 0 HP per second

Note: Regen is off when you take damage and there is an activation delay (triggered after the last received damage)
[list]
[*][b]HEALTH BONUS (NEW)[/b]
[/list]
Each time you destroy an enemy, you get 5 HP (capped to 100)
This is true in all difficulty modes.
If you're halfway the map and you only have 10 HP left now you still have a chance to make a comeback if you're playing very well.
[list]
[*][b]ENCOUNTERS[/b]
[/list]
- All enemies have been reworked and some turrets are now MUCH more aggressive.
- Lasers are now causing more damage.
[list]
[*][b]MOVEMENT [/b]
[/list]
- You now move faster while aiming (iron sight)
- New settings and tweaks available for controllers in the option menu
[list]
[*][b]OTHERS[/b]
[/list]
- 1 new weapon: AK74 (available in half a dozen challenges)
- Hit Indicator (useful in iron sight for mid/long target)

[h1][u][b]CHALLENGES[/b][/u][/h1]

- All challenges have been renamed. Names are now more in line with our technological theme.
- All challenges have been reworked to support our new gameplay intentions
- One completely new environment (visible in challenges: [i]"ABORT, RETRY, FAIL ?"[/i]  and  [i]"127.0.0.1"[/i]
- Some challenges have been temporarily removed (Gamma Normal, Hard and Very Hard). They will be back soon.
- Half a dozen new challenges for a current total of 24 challenges

[h1][u][b]INTERFACE (UI + HUD)[/b][/u][/h1]

- MENUS reworked to support our long term intentions (technology theme)
- UI ingame now less flat (helmet shaped) still highly work-in-progress
- "LOW HEALTH" indicator when you reach a threshold (currently at 30 HP)
- Upcoming RUSH mode is now called ANOMALY mode (Placeholders in the menu have been changed accordingly)

[h1][u][b]ENGINE[/b][/u][/h1]

- Move from Unreal Engine 4.7.6 to Unreal Engine 4.8.1
- Various optimization for better framerate and stability

LAST NOTE:
We're planning a new update which will impact player movement and therefore we will reset the leaderboards for all challenges.
This update is expected in few weeks from now, we'll keep you updated here.
